summary: ArcRho Engine now writes a dependent-propagation log so a slow or failed dependent update can be diagnosed from the server.
details: runtime/logs/dependent_propagation.log records each job's queue wait, claim, per-stage elapsed time, and terminal outcome.
Failure lines keep the dataset names and full reason that the client-facing status message truncates.
The Engine's three runtime logs now share one appender with common rotation.
